name: Balthazar
backstory: Balthazar is a necromancer in service to General Ketheric Thorm, sent to the Gauntlet of Shar to retrieve the Nightsong, who is the source of Ketheric Thorm's immortality. He is proud and private by nature and patient in pursuing his own goals, but not with the timing of others helping him to achieve them.
voice_hint: undead human wizard (voiced by Roger Ringrose)
